_note: Bank-specific roles for the Barclays section. Each role is mapped to a SOC 2020 unit group using the ONS SOC 2020 coding index (Volume 2), which lists the exact job title under that code. Exposure and employment are then pulled from the main occupations dataset so every number on the bank chart shares one methodology. 'barclays_context' quotes what Barclays itself said about where the cuts fall, with the source URL in barclays_facts.json.
